chapterTag.category: AI Math Unit 6 — Linear Models & OLS
topics: Simple linear regression: y = mx + b
Residuals, MSE and R² coefficient of determination

body.en: Linear regression is the foundational predictive model in data science. We explore both algebraic least-squares minimization and the closed-form matrix Normal Equation used across analytics libraries.

For a linear model \( \mathbf{y} = \mathbf{X}\mathbf{w} \) where \( \mathbf{X} \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times (d+1)} \) is the design matrix (including a column of ones for intercept), the weight vector \( \mathbf{w} \) that minimizes the sum of squared errors \( \|\mathbf{y} - \mathbf{X}\mathbf{w}\|^2 \) satisfies:
\[ \mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{X} \mathbf{w} = \mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{y} \implies \mathbf{w} = (\mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{X})^{-1} \mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{y} \]
provided \( \mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{X} \) is invertible (non-singular).

body.en: Proportional Invariance, Linear Structure & Quantitative Modeling: Across Mathematics for Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, multi-step problems reduce to identifying invariant quantities—constant rates of change \(m = \dfrac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}\), conservation of total work/mass, or linear system rank conditions. A two-variable linear system \(a_1 x + b_1 y = c_1\), \(a_2 x + b_2 y = c_2\) has a unique intersection if \(\dfrac{a_1}{a_2} \ne \dfrac{b_1}{b_2}\), no solution (parallel lines) if \(\dfrac{a_1}{a_2} = \dfrac{b_1}{b_2} \ne \dfrac{c_1}{c_2}\), and infinitely many solutions if all three ratios coincide.

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Linear Regression & Ordinary Least Squares)
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه القاعدة — الاشتقاق الرياضي (الانحدار الخطي وطريقة المربعات الصغرى (OLS))

body.en:
Why Successive Multipliers & Harmonic Average Speed Work: If a quantity \(Q_0\) undergoes a percentage change \(p\%\) followed by \(q\%\), the compound multiplier is the product of individual scale factors:

\[ Q_{\text{final}} = Q_0\left(1 + \frac{p}{100}\right)\!\left(1 + \frac{q}{100}\right) = Q_0\left(1 + \frac{p + q}{100} + \frac{pq}{10000}\right) \]

Notice the cross term \(\dfrac{pq}{10000}\): an increase of \(p\%\) followed by a decrease of \(p\%\) yields \(Q_0\bigl(1 - (p/100)^2\bigr) < Q_0\). Similarly, traveling equal distance \(d\) at speeds \(v_1\) and \(v_2\) takes total time \(T = \frac{d}{v_1} + \frac{d}{v_2}\), so average speed is the harmonic mean \(v_{\text{avg}} = \dfrac{2d}{d/v_1 + d/v_2} = \dfrac{2v_1 v_2}{v_1 + v_2}\).
body.ar: برهان النسب المتتالية والسرعة المتوسطة التوافقية: عند زيادة مقدار بنسبة \(p\%\) ثم خفضه بنسبة \(p\%\) يكون الناتج \(Q_0(1 - (p/100)^2) < Q_0\)، والسرعة المتوسطة لرحلتين متساويتين في المسافة هي الوسط التوافقي \(\frac{2v_1 v_2}{v_1 + v_2}\).

label.en: Worked Example 6.A — Closed-Form Matrix Normal Equation

body.en:
Fit a line \( y = w_1 x + w_0 \) to three points: \( (1, 2) \), \( (2, 3) \), and \( (3, 5) \) using the Normal Equation.

Solution:
1. Set up design matrix \( \mathbf{X} \) (with bias column) and target \( \mathbf{y} \):
\[ \mathbf{X} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 \\ 3 & 1 \end{pmatrix}, \quad \mathbf{y} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 3 \\ 5 \end{pmatrix} \]
2. Compute \( \mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{X} \):
\[ \mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{X} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 \\ 3 & 1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 1+4+9 & 1+2+3 \\ 1+2+3 & 1+1+1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 14 & 6 \\ 6 & 3 \end{pmatrix} \]
3. Invert \( \mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{X} \):
\( \det = (14)(3) - (6)(6) = 42 - 36 = 6 \).
\[ (\mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{X})^{-1} = \frac{1}{6} \begin{pmatrix} 3 & -6 \\ -6 & 14 \end{pmatrix} \]
4. Compute \( \mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{y} \):
\[ \mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{y} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 3 \\ 5 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 + 6 + 15 \\ 2 + 3 + 5 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 23 \\ 10 \end{pmatrix} \]
5. Compute \( \mathbf{w} = (\mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{X})^{-1} (\mathbf{X}^T \mathbf{y}) \):
\[ \mathbf{w} = \frac{1}{6} \begin{pmatrix} 3(23) - 6(10) \\ -6(23) + 14(10) \end{pmatrix} = \frac{1}{6} \begin{pmatrix} 69 - 60 \\ -138 + 140 \end{pmatrix} = \frac{1}{6} \begin{pmatrix} 9 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 1.5 \\ 0.333 \end{pmatrix} \]
Line equation: \( \hat{y} = 1.5x + \frac{1}{3} \).
Answer: Slope \( w_1 = 1.5 \), Intercept \( w_0 = \frac{1}{3} \).

Problem (Hard): An Ordinary Least Squares linear model \( \hat{B}(a) = 7a + 24 \) is evaluated at \( a = 16 \). Determine the predicted response \( \hat{B}(16) \).

Step-by-Step Solution: Evaluating \( 7(16) + 24 = 136 \).

body.en:
Problem (Easy): In gradient descent on loss \( S(b) \), parameter \( b_0 = 23 \) is updated with learning rate \( \eta = 0.1 \) and gradient \( \nabla S(b_0) = 220 \). Determine the updated parameter \( b_1 = b_0 - \eta \nabla S(b_0) \).

Step-by-Step Solution: Computing \( b_1 = 23 - 0.1(220) = 1 \).

body.en:
Problem (Medium): Principal Component Analysis on covariance matrix \( \Sigma_{W} \) yields eigenvalues \( \lambda_1 = 66 \) and \( \lambda_2 = 34 \). Determine the percentage of variance \( S_{b} \) explained by the first principal component.

Step-by-Step Solution: The percentage explained is \( \frac{66}{66+34} \times 100\% = 66\% \).

body.en:
1. Adding Successive Percentages or Averaging Speeds Arithmetically: On Mathematics for Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, a \(20\%\) discount followed by a \(20\%\) increase gives \(0.80 \times 1.20 = 0.96\) (a net \(4\%\) loss, not \(0\%\)). Likewise, average speed for a round trip at \(40\) and \(60\text{ km/h}\) is \(\dfrac{2(40)(60)}{100} = 48\text{ km/h}\), never \(50\text{ km/h}\).

2. Failing to Flip the Inequality Sign When Multiplying/Dividing by a Negative: In \(-2x + 5 \le 7\), dividing by \(-2\) strictly reverses \(\le\) to \(\ge\).
body.ar: 1. جمع النسب المئوية المتتالية أو حساب المتوسط الحسابي للسرعات: الزيادة ثم الخصم بنفس النسبة تنقص القيمة الأصلية دائماً، وعند القسمة على عدد سالب في المتباينات يجب قلب رمز المتباينة فوراً.

body.en: High-Speed Exam Shortcut (Mathematics for Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning): When a linear system asks for a combined expression like \(3x + 3y\) rather than \(x\) and \(y\) individually, add or subtract the two equations directly before isolating either variable—this often yields the target expression in a single step.
body.ar: اختصار ذهني سريع: عندما يطلب السؤال مقداراً مركباً مثل \(x+y\) في نظام معادلتين، اجمع المعادلتين أو اطرحهما مباشرةً بدلاً من إيجاد كل متغير على حدة.
